comments: Reviewed source composition, source-foot pivots and cell order. Supplemental poses are reviewed proposals, not added animation states.
Exact canvas, stamp and rule timings retained. Native cleanup and plate slicing bake once in the renderer.
Visual registration: horizontal crop centre, bottom at shared feet. Reject lowest-band mean: a stretched boot forced every pose too small.
geometry: supports()/landing() use feet and ±4 px support lip; near_ladder/step_at own rung catch. Body image cannot add reach. Down uses hit pose; no separate knockdown image.
mapping_basis: Visual review of source sheets and cleanup notes, 2026-10-15

size_basis: 48×48; canvas foot (24,48), top-left screen feet−(24,48). Seat recolour maps I/r/o/t ramp; details remain independent of tint.
timing: Ten bodies; run 2×5 ticks, climb 2×6. Landing sets pose_ticks=4 (decremented later in same step); respawn land=6, down=18, protection=30, freeze=2. Jump/fall follow velocity; victory held. COYOTE=4, BUFFER=5; movement GRAVITY=112,JUMP=1536,RUN=640,LADDER=384 fixed units (Lane::step_at).
